title: Verify: Config carries no worker or execution keys unit tests
summary: Unit tests guard the Config struct, example YAML and worker-section handling
description: Add tests to config_test.go proving REQ1 acceptance criteria with no network or real server.
acceptance_criteria: Config top-level fields are exactly the eight kept
Example YAML top-level keys are exactly the eight kept
A worker section in YAML is ignored
technical_constraints: Use reflect, os.ReadFile of ../../configs/config.example.yaml and gopkg.in/yaml.v3 already in go.mod

steps.action: Add a test that uses reflect.TypeOf(Config{}) and collects NumField names, asserting the set equals Server, Auth, Git, Hosting, Storage, Contribution, Admin, Round.
Add a test that reads ../../configs/config.example.yaml, yaml.Unmarshal into map[string]any, and asserts the keys are exactly server, auth, git, hosting, storage, contribution, admin, round.

Add a test with an fstest.MapFS YAML of 'auth:
  token_secret: s
worker:
  work_root: /tmp
'. Assert LoadFS returns no error and cfg.Auth.TokenSecret is 's'.
